intents.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name, T1.country FROM singer AS T1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.singer_id = T2.singer_id JOIN concert AS T3 ON T2.concert_id = T3.concert_id WHERE T3.year = 2014

paraphrases.text: Show the name and country of singers who performed in concerts in 2014.
List singers who appeared in any 2014 concert, showing their name and nationality.
Which artists performed live in 2014, and what country are they from?

intents.expected_sql: SELECT song_name FROM singer WHERE age > (SELECT avg(age) FROM singer)

paraphrases.text: List all song names by singers above the average age.
What songs were recorded by singers older than the mean singer age?
Show song titles from vocalists whose age exceeds the average age of all singers.

intents.expected_sql: SELECT location, name FROM stadium WHERE capacity BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000

paraphrases.text: Show location and name for all stadiums with a capacity between 5000 and 10000.
What are the names and locations of stadiums that hold between 5000 and 10000 people?
Find the site and title of every arena with seating capacity from 5000 to 10000.

intents.expected_sql: SELECT name FROM singer WHERE singer_id NOT IN (SELECT singer_id FROM singer_in_concert)

paraphrases.text: Show the names of singers who have not performed in any concert.
Which singers have never appeared at any concert?
List vocalist names that have no concert participation on record.

intents.expected_sql: SELECT T2.name, max(T1.year) FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id = T2.stadium_id GROUP BY T1.stadium_id

paraphrases.text: Show stadium names and the highest year of concerts held in each stadium.
For each venue, what is the most recent concert year, and what is the stadium called?
List each stadium's name along with the latest year it hosted a concert.

intents.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM singer AS T1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.singer_id = T2.singer_id JOIN concert AS T3 ON T2.concert_id = T3.concert_id WHERE T3.theme = 'Musicals'

paraphrases.text: List the names of singers who performed in any concert with theme 'Musicals'.
Which artists have appeared in concerts themed around Musicals?
Find singers who participated in at least one concert where the theme was Musicals.

intents.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name, T1.country FROM singer AS T1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.singer_id = T2.singer_id JOIN concert AS T3 ON T2.concert_id = T3.concert_id JOIN stadium AS T4 ON T3.stadium_id = T4.stadium_id WHERE T4.capacity > 5000

paraphrases.text: Show the names and countries of singers who have performed at stadiums with a capacity above 5000.
Which artists have played at large venues holding over 5000 people? Show their name and country.
List the name and nationality of singers who performed in stadiums with capacity greater than 5000.

intents.expected_sql: SELECT avg(sub.cnt) FROM (SELECT concert_id, count(singer_id) AS cnt FROM singer_in_concert GROUP BY concert_id) sub

paraphrases.text: What is the average number of singers per concert?
On average, how many singers appear in each individual concert?
Calculate the mean count of vocalists participating per concert event.

intents.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(sum(CASE WHEN is_male = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) * 100 / count(singer_id) FROM singer

paraphrases.text: What percentage of singers are male?
How many percent of all singers in the database are male?
Calculate the proportion of male singers out of all singers as a percentage.

intents.expected_sql: SELECT T1.name, count(DISTINCT T3.singer_id) AS total FROM stadium AS T1 JOIN concert AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id = T2.stadium_id JOIN singer_in_concert AS T3 ON T2.concert_id = T3.concert_id GROUP BY T1.stadium_id, T1.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 3

paraphrases.text: Show the top 3 stadiums with the most distinct singers who have performed there, along with the singer count.
Which 3 venues have hosted the greatest variety of different singers? Show the stadium name and count.
Find the top 3 arenas ranked by the number of unique artists who performed there.
